nodes.odebrane.text.t: Dobrosława undoes three knots and raises her eyebrows. "Spoons. Twelve of them. What do I want with twelve spoons? Oh, so there's someone to eat the soup when my husband comes back." She nods at you. "Go on, I've no room in here for thank-yous."

nodes.s.text.t: The miller's wife wipes her hands on her apron and sizes you up. "What? The flour's on the other side of the river, and my husband's in hell."
